CustomField.description: Total discount amount for this line item including volume discount, contracted discount, and additional discount.
CustomField.formula: IF(Bundled__c, 0, IF(ISPICKVAL(DiscountScheduleType__c, 'Slab') && NOT(Existing__c), (ProratedListPrice__c * Quantity__c - CustomerPrice__c), IF(ISPICKVAL(DiscountScheduleType__c, 'Slab') && Existing__c, (ProratedListPrice__c * (Quantity__c-PriorQuantity__c) - CustomerPrice__c), (ProratedListPrice__c - CustomerPrice__c) * EffectiveQuantity__c)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Total discount amount for this line item including volume discount, contracted discount, and additional discount.
CustomField.label: Total Discount (Amt)
